summary: The geometric assertion and its weighted consequence are proved without mathematical errors or gaps. The minimum-simplex argument, saturated-lattice reduction, modulo-four collision, and triangle sections establish the stated line concentration. In each pure high-weight class, completeness and affinity force the intervening line points to remain high-weight, making the partner parity nonmixed and justifying the ordered-pair inflow bound. The cut identity and Cauchy--Schwarz yield the stated mixed-center estimate. The J=4 case satisfies all hypotheses of the accepted general order-tail estimate. Both accepted facts are used with their original full rows, occupied-parity count, and normalization, and the final constant 196 follows correctly.
